reports.title: NetEase Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

desk.headline: Revenue down 1.8% to RMB27.9bn and adjusted EPS of RMB14.21 per ADS, both below estimates; no guidance given
results: Revenue slipped 1.8% to RMB27.9bn and fell 7.5% from the June quarter; games revenue dropped 1.7% to RMB22.9bn as some in-house titles earned less.
Profitability improved: lower revenue-sharing costs lifted gross profit 4.8% to RMB19.0bn, and operating profit rose to RMB9.4bn from RMB8.0bn.
Adjusted net income was RMB9.2bn, down from RMB9.5bn; adjusted diluted EPS of RMB14.21 per ADS was well short of the RMB16.07 estimate.
Youdao revenue fell 12.3% to RMB1.4bn and Cloud Music was flat at RMB1.9bn; innovative businesses grew 7.1% to RMB1.5bn.
Operating cash flow was RMB10.5bn; dividend raised to US$0.585 per ADS, and US$2.3bn of a US$5.0bn buyback has been used.

guidance.summary: NetEase gives no revenue or profit guidance. The main forward marker is the global launch of its open-world game Ananta on 15 January 2027.

points: Finance VP Aileen Mo put the drop from the June quarter down to lower revenue from certain self-developed games.
Ananta is set for a 15 Jan 2027 launch on PC, PlayStation 5 and mobile; management said it is aiming for wide reach and long player lifetimes rather than high spend per player.
Marvel Rivals and Where Winds Meet (over 100 million players) keep getting big content updates, with one large map update a year planned for Where Winds Meet.
Blizzard titles did well in China: World of Warcraft: Forever, launched 5 Nov, set a China record.
CEO William Ding said AI brings big efficiency gains but helps less with new gameplay ideas.
